title: Berry Baked Oats
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein berry baked oats cake for breakfast? we're in! these berry-studded baked oats are warm, fluffy, and oh-so-filling. if you're after something cute and cozy, just mix, bake, and dive in, doll! 24 g prep: 5 mins k total: 20 mins ingredients 50g oats 90g egg whites (3) serving calories protein carbs fat fibre 80g smooth fat-free cottage cheese 3g powdered sweetener* pinch of salt instructions 1. preheat the oven to 1800c. 1/2 tsp baking powder pinch of cinnamon spray & cook 40g blueberries 40g raspberries 2. in a blender, combine the oats, sweetener. salt, baking powder, cinnamon, egg whites, and cottage cheese. blend until smooth. 3. lightly spray an oven-safe bowl with cooking spray. 4. pour the blended mixture into the bowl and gently fold in the blueberries and raspberries. 5. sprinkle with a little extra cinnamon. 6. bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown. 7. serve and enjoy warm! mo} 4ip: if you love a semi-baked, cake "her-like lex'ure, bake for 12-15 minu+es/ easy subs: frozen berries work perfec+ly here/ i always keep a dash in 'he freezer - no' only are +hey more cos'- effec+ive. +hey day fresh much longer +00/ no/es: meal prep friendly freezer friendly x *see substitutions section 64 tried it favourite from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. 1/2 Tsp Baking Powder Pinch of Cinnamon Spray & Cook 40g Blueberries 40g Raspberries
In a blender, combine the oats, sweetener. salt, baking powder, cinnamon, egg whites, and cottage cheese. Blend until smooth.
Lightly spray an oven-safe bowl with cooking spray.
Pour the blended mixture into the bowl and gently fold in the blueberries and raspberries.
Sprinkle with a little extra cinnamon.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

Serve and enjoy warm!
